I added `tests/test_payments.py` with 9 tests for `line_total`, `order_total` and `refund`. I also added an empty `tests/__init__.py`. `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes, with 8 normal passes and 1 expected failure. I didn't change anything under `shop/`.

I found one bug. `refund()` does no validation, so refunding more than the order total returns a negative balance. For example, `refund(100, 150)` returns `-50`. I kept a test that expects a `ValueError` there and marked it `@unittest.expectedFailure`. The right behavior is your call; if you want it to raise, fix `refund()` and remove the marker.
